title: seher-ts config
description: Provider/mode/YAML configuration for the seher CLI. Loaded as YAML from (in order) `-c <path>`, `$SEHER_CONFIG`, `~/.config/seher/config.yaml`. Follows the same JSON Schema shape as the Rust `seher` implementation, and can be used by editor extensions for completion/validation.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema URI for editor validation/completion.

skills.description: Top-level skill auto-detection defaults. Can be overridden per-provider via the `skills` block.

retry.description: Top-level retry policy defaults. Can be overridden per-provider via the `retry` block. When a provider-level setting is defined, it replaces the entire root block; fields are not merged individually.

effort.description: Top-level reasoning effort default, used as the final fallback when neither the provider nor the model entry specifies one (see the `effort` field on `providerEntry` and `modelEntry`).

env.description: Top-level extra environment variables injected for every provider. Provider-level `env` keys override these on a per-key basis (see `env` on `providerEntry`). Not supported for `cursor` (local mode) / `opencode`, which strip and warn.

providers.description: Map of provider key → provider entry. Insertion order in the YAML is preserved as the tiebreaker for equal priority. The map key is used as both the provider label and the default provider name.

effortLevel.description: Reasoning effort level forwarded to backends that support it (`claude` / `claude-headless` / `claude-terminal` via `--effort`; `pi` via a mapped thinking level; `codex` / `copilot` via their native reasoning-effort fields). `max` has no native equivalent on `pi`/`codex`/`copilot` and is rounded down to their highest tier (`xhigh`). Not wired for `kimi` / `cursor` / `opencode`.

sdkKind.description: The execution engine type. `pi` / `claude` / `claude-headless` / `claude-terminal` are available at runtime depending on tool support. The others (`codex` / `copilot` / `cursor` / `kimi` / `opencode`) are additional backends specific to seher-ts.

includeClaude.description: Whether to auto-detect Claude-format skills (`~/.claude/skills`, `<cwd>/.claude/skills`). Default: true.

retryConfig.description: Exponential backoff retry policy for transient provider API errors. Provider-level settings replace the root settings as a whole block (not merged field by field). Unspecified fields use the defaults below.

enabled.description: Whether to enable retries. Default: true.

maxAttempts.description: Maximum number of attempts before giving up. Default: 5.

initialDelaySecs.description: Seconds to wait before the first retry. Default: 2.

maxDelaySecs.description: Upper bound in seconds for the retry interval. Default: 60.

multiplier.description: Multiplier applied to the delay on each retry. Default: 2.0.

retryClientErrors.description: Opt-in flag to also retry HTTP 401/404 responses. Enable only when acceptable, since some providers return these even for transient failures. Default: false.

modelEntry.description: A bare model id (string), or an object in `{ model, priority, effort }` form. The model id is in `provider/model` format. Reasoning effort is resolved with `model > provider > root` precedence (see `effort` below and on `providerEntry`/the root), falling back further to a trailing `:level` suffix on the model id (recognized for every `sdk`, not just `pi`) when none of the three specify one.

oneOf.description: A bare model id. Priority and effort are inherited from the provider/root level.

model.description: The model id passed to the SDK.

priority.description: Model-level priority. If specified, it takes precedence over the provider-level `priority`.

effort.description: Model-level reasoning effort. Takes precedence over the provider-level and root-level `effort`, and over a `:level` suffix on `model`.

providerApi.description: Per-provider API settings forwarded to the SDK constructor.

key.description: The API key (e.g. equivalent to ANTHROPIC_API_KEY). When running via pi, omitting this defers to pi's own auth.json / environment variable resolution.

endpoint.description: Override for the API endpoint (equivalent to the provider's baseURL).

provider.description: Explicit provider name. When omitted, the YAML map key is used as-is. Serves as the basis for the built-in SDK's default mapping, CodexBar usage queries, and the `-p` filter.

sdk.description: Explicitly specify the SDK. Required when the `provider` field (or YAML map key) is a name outside the built-in set. `sdk: pi` can use pi's own auth resolution, so it works without `api`.

priority.description: Provider-level shorthand priority. Used when individual model entries don't have their own priority. Higher values take precedence; ties are broken by order of appearance in the YAML.

retry.description: Per-provider override of the top-level `retry`. The entire block is replaced rather than merged field by field.

effort.description: Provider-level reasoning effort default. Overridden by a model entry's own `effort`. Falls back to the top-level `effort` when unset.

env.description: Extra environment variables injected when this provider executes. Merged with the top-level `env` on a per-key basis, with these values taking precedence. For `pi` (in-process), applied by temporarily mutating `process.env` for the duration of the run. Not supported for `cursor` (local mode) / `opencode`, which strip and warn.

models.description: Map of mode key (`plan` / `build` / any key) → model entry. A provider with no models at all is rejected at load time.
